WITH g AS (SELECT source_relation, CAST(date_day AS TIMESTAMP) AS date_day, app_id, source_type, app_version FROM intermediate.int_apple_store__app_version_report),
cr AS (SELECT source_relation, date_day, app_id, source_type, app_version, crashes FROM intermediate.int_apple_store__app_version_app_crashes),
inst AS (SELECT source_relation, date_day, app_id, source_type, app_version, SUM(installations) AS installations, SUM(deletions) AS deletions FROM intermediate.int_apple_store__app_version_install_deletions GROUP BY source_relation, date_day, app_id, source_type, app_version),
ses AS (SELECT source_relation, date_day, app_id, source_type, app_version, SUM(sessions) AS sessions, SUM(active_devices) AS active_devices FROM intermediate.int_apple_store__app_version_sessions_activity GROUP BY source_relation, date_day, app_id, source_type, app_version),
app AS (SELECT source_relation, app_id, app_name FROM intermediate.int_apple_store__app_dim)
SELECT g.source_relation,
       g.date_day,
       g.app_id,
       app.app_name,
       g.source_type,
       g.app_version,
       COALESCE(cr.crashes, 0) AS crashes,
       COALESCE(inst.installations, 0) AS installations,
       COALESCE(inst.deletions, 0) AS deletions,
       COALESCE(ses.sessions, 0) AS sessions,
       COALESCE(ses.active_devices, 0) AS active_devices
FROM g
LEFT JOIN cr ON g.source_relation IS NOT DISTINCT FROM cr.source_relation AND g.date_day IS NOT DISTINCT FROM cr.date_day AND g.app_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM cr.app_id AND g.source_type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM cr.source_type AND g.app_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM cr.app_version
LEFT JOIN inst ON g.source_relation IS NOT DISTINCT FROM inst.source_relation AND g.date_day IS NOT DISTINCT FROM inst.date_day AND g.app_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM inst.app_id AND g.source_type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM inst.source_type AND g.app_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM inst.app_version
LEFT JOIN ses ON g.source_relation IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ses.source_relation AND g.date_day IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ses.date_day AND g.app_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ses.app_id AND g.source_type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ses.source_type AND g.app_version IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ses.app_version
LEFT JOIN app ON g.source_relation IS NOT DISTINCT FROM app.source_relation AND g.app_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM app.app_id

blocks.original_text:
- name: apple_store__app_version_report
      description: Daily app-version metrics by source_type per app and source_relation; rows follow reporting_grain and missing metrics are output as 0
      grain: One row per source_relation, date_day, app_id, source_type, app_version
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__app_version_report
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__app_dim
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__app_version_app_crashes
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__app_version_install_deletions
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__app_version_sessions_activity
      business_logic: '- Drive the output from intermediate.int_apple_store__app_version_report (reporting_grain), emitting exactly one row per (source_relation, date_day, app_id, source_type, app_version). - Crashes: join intermediate.int_apple_store__app_version_app_crashes at the same grain without further aggregation. - Installations and deletions: sum per (app_id, date_day, app_version, source_type, source_relation) in intermediate.int_apple_store__app_version_install_deletions before joining. - Sessions and active_devices: sum per (app_id, date_day, app_version, source_type, source_relation) in intermediate.int_apple_store__app_version_sessions_activity before joining. - Left join each metric set to reporting_grain on (app_id, date_day, app_version, source_type, source_relation). - Left join app_name from intermediate.int_apple_store__app_dim on (app_id, source_relation). - Convert NULL metric values to 0; preserve original values otherwise. No sorting or rounding is applied.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier from reporting_grain; part of the grain
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: date_day
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Reporting day from reporting_grain; matched on exact equality
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: App identifier from reporting_grain; part of the grain
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: App name joined from app_dim by (app_id, source_relation); NULL if no match
      - name: source_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Traffic/source category from reporting_grain; part of the grain
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_version
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: App version from reporting_grain; part of the grain
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: crashes
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Crash count taken at the reporting grain; NULLs replaced with 0
      - name: deletions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Deletion count summed per grain from install_deletions; NULLs replaced with 0
      - name: installations
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Installation count summed per grain from install_deletions; NULLs replaced with 0
      - name: active_devices
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Active device count summed per grain from sessions_activity; NULLs replaced with 0
      - name: sessions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Session count summed per grain from sessions_activity; NULLs replaced with 0

WITH g AS (SELECT date_day, vendor_number, app_apple_id, app_name, subscription_name, country, state, source_relation FROM intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_report),
s AS (SELECT vendor_number, app_apple_id, date_day, subscription_name, country, state, source_relation, active_free_trial_introductory_offer_subscriptions, active_pay_as_you_go_introductory_offer_subscriptions, active_pay_up_front_introductory_offer_subscriptions, active_standard_price_subscriptions FROM intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_summary),
e AS (SELECT vendor_number, app_apple_id, date_day, subscription_name, country, state, source_relation, event_renew, event_cancel, event_subscribe FROM intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_events),
cc AS (SELECT country_code_alpha_2, alternative_country_name, country_name, region, sub_region FROM intermediate.int_apple_store__country_codes)
SELECT g.date_day,
       g.vendor_number,
       g.app_apple_id,
       g.app_name,
       g.subscription_name,
       COALESCE(cc.alternative_country_name, cc.country_name) AS territory_long,
       g.country AS territory_short,
       g.state,
       cc.region,
       cc.sub_region,
       g.source_relation,
       COALESCE(s.active_free_trial_introductory_offer_subscriptions, 0) AS active_free_trial_introductory_offer_subscriptions,
       COALESCE(s.active_pay_as_you_go_introductory_offer_subscriptions, 0) AS active_pay_as_you_go_introductory_offer_subscriptions,
       COALESCE(s.active_pay_up_front_introductory_offer_subscriptions, 0) AS active_pay_up_front_introductory_offer_subscriptions,
       COALESCE(s.active_standard_price_subscriptions, 0) AS active_standard_price_subscriptions,
       COALESCE(e.event_renew, 0) AS event_renew,
       COALESCE(e.event_cancel, 0) AS event_cancel,
       COALESCE(e.event_subscribe, 0) AS event_subscribe
FROM g
LEFT JOIN s ON g.vendor_number IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.vendor_number AND g.app_apple_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.app_apple_id AND g.date_day IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.date_day AND g.subscription_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.subscription_name AND g.country IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.country AND g.state IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.state AND g.source_relation IS NOT DISTINCT FROM s.source_relation
LEFT JOIN e ON g.vendor_number IS NOT DISTINCT FROM e.vendor_number AND g.app_apple_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM e.app_apple_id AND g.date_day IS NOT DISTINCT FROM e.date_day AND g.subscription_name IS NOT DISTINCT FROM e.subscription_name AND g.country IS NOT DISTINCT FROM e.country AND g.state IS NOT DISTINCT FROM e.state AND g.source_relation IS NOT DISTINCT FROM e.source_relation
LEFT JOIN cc ON g.country = cc.country_code_alpha_2

blocks.original_text:
- name: apple_store__subscription_report
      description: Daily subscription KPIs per product and territory; joins summary and events to the reporting grain and enriches with country names/regions; missing measures are zero-filled.
      grain: One row per date_day × vendor_number × app_apple_id × subscription_name × territory_short × state × source_relation
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_report
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_summary
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_events
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__country_codes
      business_logic: '- Use intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_report as the driver; output one row per key: date_day, vendor_number, app_apple_id, subscription_name, country (as territory_short), state, source_relation. - Left join intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_summary on vendor_number, app_apple_id, date_day, subscription_name, country, state, and source_relation to bring active_* measures. - Left join intermediate.int_apple_store__subscription_events on the same keys to bring event_* measures. - Left join intermediate.int_apple_store__country_codes on country_code_alpha_2 = reporting country; set territory_long to alternative country name when available, otherwise the standard country name; set region and sub_region from the match. - Pass through app_name and source_relation from the reporting grain; set territory_short from the reporting country and state from the reporting state. - Null handling: replace missing active_* and event_* measures with 0; geography fields from country_codes are null when no country match; other string fields are passed through unchanged. - No aggregation, sorting, or filtering is applied; row multiplicity follows the joins and assumes uniqueness of joined sources on the stated keys.'
      columns:
      - name: date_day
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Day timestamp from the reporting grain; used in joins; no timezone conversion.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: vendor_number
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Vendor identifier from the reporting grain; part of the join keys.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_apple_id
        data_type: INTEGER
        description: Application Apple ID from the reporting grain; part of the join keys.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: app_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application name passed through from the reporting grain.
      - name: subscription_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Subscription product name from the reporting grain; part of the join keys.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: territory_long
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: 'Country name from country_codes: use alternative name when available, otherwise the standard country name; null if no country match.'
      - name: territory_short
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Two-letter ISO alpha-2 country code from the reporting grain; preserved as stored.
        tests:
        - not_null
      - name: state
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: State/province code from the reporting grain; may be null.
      - name: region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Region from country_codes for the matched country; null if not found.
      - name: sub_region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sub-region from country_codes for the matched country; null if not found.
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier from the reporting grain; part of the join keys.
      - name: active_free_trial_introductory_offer_subscriptions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of active subscriptions on introductory free trials from subscription_summary; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - active_free_trial_introductory_offer_subscriptions >= 0
      - name: active_pay_as_you_go_introductory_offer_subscriptions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of active subscriptions on pay-as-you-go introductory offers from subscription_summary; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - active_pay_as_you_go_introductory_offer_subscriptions >= 0
      - name: active_pay_up_front_introductory_offer_subscriptions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of active subscriptions on pay-up-front introductory offers from subscription_summary; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - active_pay_up_front_introductory_offer_subscriptions >= 0
      - name: active_standard_price_subscriptions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Count of active subscriptions at standard price from subscription_summary; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - active_standard_price_subscriptions >= 0
      - name: event_renew
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Renewal event count from subscription_events; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - event_renew >= 0
      - name: event_cancel
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Cancel event count from subscription_events; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - event_cancel >= 0
      - name: event_subscribe
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Subscribe event count from subscription_events; zero when missing.
        tests:
        - event_subscribe >= 0

agent_sql.raw_text:
WITH g AS (SELECT source_relation, CAST(date_day AS TIMESTAMP) AS date_day, app_id, source_type, territory FROM intermediate.int_apple_store__territory_report),
app AS (SELECT source_relation, app_id, app_name FROM intermediate.int_apple_store__app_dim),
ip AS (SELECT source_relation, date_day, app_id, source_type, territory, SUM(impressions) AS impressions, SUM(impressions_unique_device) AS impressions_unique_device, SUM(page_views) AS page_views, SUM(page_views_unique_device) AS page_views_unique_device FROM intermediate.int_apple_store__territory_impressions_page_views GROUP BY source_relation, date_day, app_id, source_type, territory),
dl AS (SELECT source_relation, date_day, app_id, source_type, territory, SUM(first_time_downloads) AS first_time_downloads, SUM(redownloads) AS redownloads, SUM(total_downloads) AS total_downloads FROM intermediate.int_apple_store__territory_downloads_daily GROUP BY source_relation, date_day, app_id, source_type, territory),
ins AS (SELECT source_relation, date_day, app_id, source_type, territory, SUM(deletions) AS deletions, SUM(installations) AS installations FROM intermediate.int_apple_store__territory_install_deletions GROUP BY source_relation, date_day, app_id, source_type, territory),
ses AS (SELECT source_relation, date_day, app_id, source_type, territory, SUM(active_devices) AS active_devices, SUM(sessions) AS sessions FROM intermediate.int_apple_store__territory_sessions_activity GROUP BY source_relation, date_day, app_id, source_type, territory),
cc AS (SELECT country_code_alpha_2, alternative_country_name, country_name, region, sub_region FROM intermediate.int_apple_store__country_codes)
SELECT g.source_relation,
       g.date_day,
       g.app_id,
       app.app_name,
       COALESCE(cc.alternative_country_name, cc.country_name) AS territory_long,
       g.territory AS territory_short,
       cc.region,
       cc.sub_region,
       g.source_type,
       COALESCE(ip.impressions, 0) AS impressions,
       COALESCE(ip.impressions_unique_device, 0) AS impressions_unique_device,
       COALESCE(ip.page_views, 0) AS page_views,
       COALESCE(ip.page_views_unique_device, 0) AS page_views_unique_device,
       COALESCE(dl.first_time_downloads, 0) AS first_time_downloads,
       COALESCE(dl.redownloads, 0) AS redownloads,
       COALESCE(dl.total_downloads, 0) AS total_downloads,
       COALESCE(ins.deletions, 0) AS deletions,
       COALESCE(ins.installations, 0) AS installations,
       COALESCE(ses.active_devices, 0) AS active_devices,
       COALESCE(ses.sessions, 0) AS sessions
FROM g
LEFT JOIN ip ON g.source_relation IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ip.source_relation AND g.date_day IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ip.date_day AND g.app_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ip.app_id AND g.source_type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ip.source_type AND g.territory IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ip.territory
LEFT JOIN dl ON g.source_relation IS NOT DISTINCT FROM dl.source_relation AND g.date_day IS NOT DISTINCT FROM dl.date_day AND g.app_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM dl.app_id AND g.source_type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM dl.source_type AND g.territory IS NOT DISTINCT FROM dl.territory
LEFT JOIN ins ON g.source_relation IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ins.source_relation AND g.date_day IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ins.date_day AND g.app_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ins.app_id AND g.source_type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ins.source_type AND g.territory IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ins.territory
LEFT JOIN ses ON g.source_relation IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ses.source_relation AND g.date_day IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ses.date_day AND g.app_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ses.app_id AND g.source_type IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ses.source_type AND g.territory IS NOT DISTINCT FROM ses.territory
LEFT JOIN app ON g.source_relation IS NOT DISTINCT FROM app.source_relation AND g.app_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM app.app_id
LEFT JOIN cc ON g.territory = cc.country_code_alpha_2

blocks.original_text:
- name: apple_store__territory_report
      description: Daily territory/source metrics per app, built from reporting grain with left-joined measures and country metadata, zero-filled for missing measures.
      grain: One row per (source_relation, date_day, app_id, source_type, territory) from intermediate.int_apple_store__territory_report
      source_models:
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__territory_report
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__app_dim
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__territory_impressions_page_views
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__territory_downloads_daily
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__territory_install_deletions
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__territory_sessions_activity
      - intermediate.int_apple_store__country_codes
      business_logic: '- Start from intermediate.int_apple_store__territory_report as the complete reporting grain: one row per (source_relation, date_day, app_id, source_type, territory). - LEFT JOIN app_dim on app_id and source_relation to add app_name; if no match, app_name is NULL. - LEFT JOIN territory_impressions_page_views on app_id, date_day, source_type, territory, and source_relation; set impressions, impressions_unique_device, page_views, and page_views_unique_device to 0 when missing. - LEFT JOIN territory_downloads_daily on the same keys; set first_time_downloads, redownloads, and total_downloads to 0 when missing. - LEFT JOIN territory_install_deletions on the same keys; set deletions and installations to 0 when missing. - LEFT JOIN territory_sessions_activity on the same keys; set active_devices and sessions to 0 when missing. - LEFT JOIN country_codes on territory equals the two-letter country code; set territory_long to the alternative country name when available, otherwise the standard country name; territory_short mirrors the source territory code and is NULL only when the source territory is NULL; region and sub_region come from country_codes and are NULL when no match. - No aggregation or sorting is applied; base rows are preserved and any duplicates in joined sources will propagate. String casing and spacing are unchanged, and date_day is not truncated or timezone-adjusted.'
      columns:
      - name: source_relation
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Source system identifier from the reporting grain, also used in all joins.
      - name: date_day
        data_type: TIMESTAMP
        description: Timestamp from the reporting grain; intended as a day but any time component is preserved.
      - name: app_id
        data_type: BIGINT
        description: Application identifier from the reporting grain and the join key to all metric tables and app_dim.
      - name: app_name
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Application name from app_dim joined on app_id and source_relation; NULL when no match.
      - name: source_type
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Traffic source category from the reporting grain; passed through unchanged.
      - name: territory_long
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Country long name from country_codes, preferring the alternative name when present; NULL when no country_codes match.
      - name: territory_short
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Two-letter country code from the reporting grain; NULL only when the source territory is NULL.
      - name: region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Region from country_codes for the matched territory; NULL when no country_codes match.
      - name: sub_region
        data_type: VARCHAR
        description: Sub-region from country_codes for the matched territory; NULL when no country_codes match.
      - name: impressions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Impressions from territory_impressions_page_views at the full grain; missing values output as 0.
      - name: impressions_unique_device
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Unique-device impressions from territory_impressions_page_views; missing values output as 0.
      - name: page_views
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Page views from territory_impressions_page_views; missing values output as 0.
      - name: page_views_unique_device
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Unique-device page views from territory_impressions_page_views; missing values output as 0.
      - name: first_time_downloads
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: First-time downloads from territory_downloads_daily; missing values output as 0.
      - name: redownloads
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Redownloads from territory_downloads_daily; missing values output as 0.
      - name: total_downloads
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Total downloads from territory_downloads_daily; missing values output as 0.
      - name: active_devices
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Active devices from territory_sessions_activity; missing values output as 0.
      - name: deletions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: App deletions from territory_install_deletions; missing values output as 0.
      - name: installations
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: App installations from territory_install_deletions; missing values output as 0.
      - name: sessions
        data_type: HUGEINT
        description: Sessions from territory_sessions_activity; missing values output as 0.
